opening.argument: The material is presented as an explanation and screen walkthrough of ways to work online, including freelancing, outsourcing, and affiliate marketing. Its stated purpose is to explain “how to really you can earn money online in this year at your home with freelancing and outsourcing,” while the affiliate screens show an account, referral statistics, promotional-material fields, and balance and withdrawal figures. A registration page requests account details, but these materials do not establish deception, payment loss, misuse of submitted information, or a completed transaction. The separate invitation to “Visit our website to buy our online courses” and the subscribe and channel-branding overlays are ordinary promotional and audience-engagement features, not proof of an outcome or harm.
